//  SDW - Validate task w/ simple input and output


module main;

reg globvar;
reg in1;
reg error;

task my_task ;
  input in1;
  output out1;
  out1 = in1;
endtask

initial
  begin
    error = 0;
    my_task(1'b1,globvar);
    if(~globvar)
      begin
        $display("FAILED - task 3.14C task didn't correctly affect global var(1)");
         error = 1;
      end

    in1 = 0;
    my_task(!in1,globvar);
    if(~globvar)
      begin
         $display("FAILED - task 3.14C task didn't correctly affect global var(2)");
         error = 1;
      end
    if(error == 0)
       $display("PASSED");
  end

endmodule // main
